quiz.intro.2: Good. Don't be afraid. You are about to wake up in a world that is not yours.
quiz.intro.3: First, answer me honestly. Your answers will tell who you really are.
quiz.q.lantern: You are walking at night and your lantern suddenly goes out. What do you do?
quiz.q.lantern.a1: I keep going in the dark.
quiz.q.lantern.a3: I laugh. Someone must be playing a trick on me.
quiz.q.mask: Someone offers you a mask that gives you anyone's face. Do you take it?
quiz.q.mask.a1: Yes, and I'll use it to play pranks.
quiz.q.mask.a2: No. I like being who I am.
quiz.q.mask.a3: Yes, so nobody ever recognises me again.
quiz.q.friend: Someone you love is crying and won't tell you why. What do you do?
quiz.q.friend.a1: I sit beside them without a word.
quiz.q.friend.a2: I tease them until they laugh.
quiz.q.friend.a3: I go after whoever hurt them.
quiz.q.mirror: In an old mirror, your reflection moves a second late. What do you do?
quiz.q.mirror.a1: I stick my tongue out at it and see what it does.
quiz.q.mirror.a2: I back away slowly and never look again.
quiz.q.mirror.a3: I wave. Maybe it wants to play.
quiz.q.storm: A storm traps you in a cabin with strangers. What do you do?
quiz.q.storm.a1: I set up shifts to watch the door.
quiz.q.storm.a2: I tell ghost stories to liven up the night.
quiz.q.storm.a3: I find a quiet corner and wait it out.
quiz.q.keepsake: You find something that belonged to someone who is gone. What do you do?
quiz.q.keepsake.a1: I keep it and carry it with me always.
quiz.q.keepsake.a2: I leave it where it was. It isn't mine.
quiz.q.keepsake.a3: I try it on to see how it looks on me.
quiz.q.voice: Someone calls your name from a dark corridor. What do you do?
quiz.q.voice.a2: I pretend I didn't hear anything.
quiz.q.voice.a3: I walk towards the voice. I'm curious.
quiz.q.wish: If you could make one wish tonight, what would it be?
quiz.q.wish.a1: That nobody would ever feel alone again.
quiz.q.wish.a3: That the world were a little stranger.
quiz.nature.brave.text: You don't run when things turn ugly. You stand your ground, even with shaking legs.
quiz.nature.calm.text: You listen before you act. Your calm is a small light that guides others through the dark.
quiz.nature.hardy.text: You carry whatever must be carried without complaint. What you lose, you keep with you.
quiz.nature.jolly.text: Even on the blackest night you find something to laugh about, and your laughter spreads.
quiz.nature.lonely.text: You hide from others, but deep down you only want someone to love you as you are.
quiz.nature.quirky.text: Nobody ever knows what you'll do next. Not even you. And you love it.
quiz.nature.sassy.text: You say what you think and poke fun at anyone who takes things too seriously.
quiz.nature.timid.text: You startle easily, but you see danger before anyone else.
quiz.title: Personality test
quiz.chooseTitle: Who do you want to be?
quiz.notPlayable: This Pokémon can't explore yet. For now you'll wake up as Mimikyu.

passive.disguise.description: The first hit you take in each room deals no damage and breaks the disguise.
move.fury-swipes.description: Five quick scratches in front of you. Normal: good against Dark.

move.foul-play.description: A charged lunge; deals more damage if the enemy is attacking.
move.ember.description: A small, fast flame at range. Free.
move.astonish.description: A point-blank scare that staggers and pushes the enemy away.
move.hex.description: A slow wisp; double damage if the enemy is staggered. Hold to charge.
move.inferno.description: A big, very slow and very strong fireball. Hold to charge.
move.bone-club.description: A short bone swing that staggers hard.
move.bone-rush.description: Three bone jabs while you slowly move forward.
move.bonemerang.description: You throw the bone: it flies out and back, hitting on both passes. Hold to charge.
move.stomping-tantrum.description: A charged stomp all around; twice as strong if your previous attack missed.
passive.illusion.description: You enter each room disguised: sleeping enemies do not notice you until you touch them, and your first hit is critical.
passive.flash-fire.description: Fire-type attacks do not hurt you: they heal you a little and power up your next heavy move.
passive.battle-armor.description: While you charge or wind up a heavy move, hits from the front deal half damage.
